reviewer: Independent Korean semantic reviewer; not Korean translator
body_hash_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon))
method: Read all 90 complete Chinese/Korean unit pairs in three batches of 30, including full four-question table and complete book/craft/neighbor-kiln narrative. HTML tags/attributes checked separately.
findings: Same bearer and operational first-person action-order conditions retained; preference examples do not collapse into conflict.
Binary constitutive standing remains distinct from gradual formation and operational ambiguity. Joint realizability concerns actions rather than standing.
Urgent starvation counterexample and windows versus reversibility preserve anti-ranking argument. Yielding does not constitute withdrawal; four questions stay separate.
Adjudication domain excludes merely habitual, exhausted or externally scripted action; choosing cannot certify the avowals it presupposes.
Five grounds have local dependencies but no algorithm or weights; irreversibility retains its three subjects.
Neighbor agreement, collective-bearer reservation, coercion versus colonization, equal-importance rejection and all handovers retained. No substantive omission or unsupported strengthening found.
limitations: Independent translation fidelity review, not external philosophical fact-checking.
Pass applies to recorded body/file hashes.
